initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Bakery Equipment and Supplies
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

We are preparing for an expansion of our bakery and would like to request a quote for several items needed for our new location. To ensure we have everything required for our operations, please provide pricing and availability for the following:

- Industrial Dough Mixer (preferably 20L capacity)
- Commercial Bread Proofer
- French Baguette Flour (bulk, 25kg bags)

If you require any additional information about the specifications or brands, please let us know. We are looking for reliable equipment and high-quality ingredients suitable for artisan bread production. Kindly include lead times and any relevant warranty details in your response.

Best regards,
French Bakery

test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote for items that are not present in the available catalog, triggering an intervention due to no catalog match for all requested items.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: ToyMaster Deluxe Train & Rainbow Racer Set
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of Chevy Toys as we are in the process of expanding our product offerings and are currently sourcing new items for our upcoming collection. We are particularly interested in obtaining a detailed quote for the following products, which we have seen referenced in various industry publications and at recent trade shows:

1. ToyMaster Deluxe Train Set (full set, including all track extensions and remote control features)
2. Rainbow Racer Set (the version with interchangeable color panels and dual-speed modes)

If possible, please include any relevant information about bulk pricing, lead times, and available warranty or support options for these items. If you require additional details to process this request, please let me know. We are eager to review your quotation at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Chevy Toys

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for New Items
initial_turn.body:

I'm looking to get a quote for a few things we're hoping to stock for our upcoming summer event. I couldn't find these on your website, but maybe you carry them or can source them for us?

Here's what we're after:
- Rainbow Picnic Blanket (we need something large and waterproof, preferably with a carrying strap)
- Eco-Friendly Water Bottles (ideally BPA-free, 500ml size, assorted colors)
- Solar Lanterns for outdoor use (something compact, rechargeable, and bright)

If you need more info about specs or brands, just let me know. We're hoping to place a bulk order, so if you have volume pricing, that would be awesome too!

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
